held_point_check.first_run_fix: 2026-11-16, camera PR 5b-i's fifth agent, after the check's first run (one pose read, the session ended before the rest): the positive control read nan. The line is never zero (its floor, 64 units in the last place over the last step, is about 2.4e-7), so the nan was not 0/0 in the control's arithmetic: the jvp itself was nan at 2506 pixels of the first pose's image, every one empty (rendered and exact share 0), 21 of them in the band. jax_debug_nans located it in _sampled._leasts: a read point's recipe counted its descent's moves as (centre - start) / spacing, and a ray that misses the widened ball has no spacing (0/0); _place then made its derivative from start + moves x spacing (nan x 0). A derivative defect of design (i), found by the positive control; the images are untouched (the recipe is read only by the derivative). Fixed in the source (the spacing guarded, the moves 0 there, exactly what the descent did), after which the jvp is finite at every pixel of the three poses (0 of 6144, x and z). The control's arithmetic is otherwise unchanged: a non-finite distance now counts as a failure explicitly (it did before only through argmax picking the nan), and the count of non-finite jvp pixels is reported.
